d:
Hazen Audel braves extreme cold and treacherous terrain in northern Canada's frozen wilderness on a challenging mission to locate a migrating caribou herd. Survival skills are his only ally in this unforgiving landscape.
Survival expert Hazen Audel takes on the planet’s toughest environments, from dense jungles to frozen wildernesses, using traditional survival skills, courage and instinct to overcome nature’s most extreme challenges.
